description: Standing query, zero results expected: no normalized event in the last three days without a timestamp, or with one more than a day from the partition it was filed under

params.query: SELECT dt, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND (time IS NULL OR from_unixtime(time / 1000) < date_parse(dt, '%Y-%m-%d') - INTERVAL '1' DAY OR from_unixtime(time / 1000) > date_parse(dt, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL '2' DAY) GROUP BY 1

matrix_rows.gap: One source: only AWS events are in the corpus, so consistency across clouds cannot be judged yet.
